changelog: New provider: Komiku — read manga, manhwa and manhua in the app: a vertical reader that loads pages in reading order, pinch to zoom on touch screens, offline chapter downloads, and reading progress and bookmarks that sync with your account.
New provider: AnimeXin — a donghua catalog with its own weekly schedule, genre and status filters, and switchable soft subtitles in the player on supported episodes (Indonesian, English, and more).
AnimeXin episodes can be downloaded for offline watching, subtitle files included — and downloads now always keep their audio, fixing silent playback on some sources.
More episodes play: titles whose only source is GDrivePlayer now resolve and play instead of showing as unavailable.
Posters and covers load faster: catalog images are resized for your screen instead of downloading the full-size originals.
A new welcome flow for first-time users: pick a provider, then sign in or continue as a guest — the app opens on your pick.
The Watch page starts faster: the player appears as soon as the video is ready, while the series details and episode list fill in below it.
Error and info messages are clearer everywhere — they say what happened and what to do next — and the crash screen is now a calm page with retry and home buttons instead of a stack of technical text.
